source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
During the opponent's Command phase, in its Battle-shock step, each enemy unit under its **Starting Strength** and within 12" of any of your **HERETIC ASTARTES** units is forced to test for Battle-shock, with −1 to the result. Enemy units this rule has affected need not take further Battle-shock tests that phase.

Attack modifiers:

- Attacks by your **HERETIC ASTARTES** models get +1 to **Hit rolls** against **Below Half-strength** units.
- Attacks by your **HERETIC ASTARTES** models get +1 to **Wound rolls** against **Battle-shocked** units.
- Attacks by Battle-shocked models against your **HERETIC ASTARTES** units get −1 to Hit rolls.
